extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. GM and every player in Obsidian should update together.
intentEvidence: Online play for Atlas VTT: host sessions, let players join from a web page or a tab, and share notes and maps.
problem: It addresses the need for a seamless way to run and participate in Atlas VTT sessions without relying on dedicated external servers or accounts.

relations.evidence: Compatible with Atlas VTT 0.12.0 (TrueScale and the player window bar), and 0.11.

summary: Connect for Atlas VTT enables users to host and join virtual tabletop sessions using Obsidian, allowing real-time map and note sharing.
